name: Energy Price
description: The going rate for the power that keeps the lights (and the racks) on.
effect_description: Higher energy prices raise the daily energy cost line in the ledger; lower prices shrink it.

name: Chip Supply
description: How easy it currently is to get your hands on compute hardware.
effect_description: Tight chip supply temporarily reduces effective compute capacity; abundant supply boosts it.

name: Talent Market
description: How competitive hiring is across the industry right now.
effect_description: A hot talent market raises new-hire salary expectations; a cold one lowers them.

name: Public Mood
description: Ambient public sentiment toward AI companies in general, independent of your own record.
effect_description: A sunny public mood nudges public trust up a little each day; a sour one nudges it down.

name: Regulation Climate
description: How aggressively regulators across the board are currently scrutinizing the industry.
effect_description: A stricter climate speeds up regulatory pressure accrual; a lax one slows it down.
